title: Section 3 — World objects
description: World object (building, resource, plant, animal…). Domain key: id. Only id and gId are always present: every other property was observed on 14.31% of the entries at most (survey of 190338 world objects, ten reference saves, 2026-09-10).

id.description: Unique identifier of the object within the save

gId.description: Game ID — type/prefab of the object (e.g. 'WindTurbineT1', 'EscapePodToxicity')

pos.description: 3D position of the object, formatted as 'x,y,z'. An object that holds a position also names the planet it stands on.

rot.description: Quaternion rotation of the object, formatted as 'x,y,z,w'

planet.description: Numeric planet id, a signed integer of either sign: four of the five values observed are negative (-1140328421 for Prime, 110910045 for Toxicity, -1016990411 for Selenea, -486276833 for Humble, -1291310150 for Aqualis)

count.description: Accumulated quantity or state (e.g. '0,125' for an ore deposit)

grwth.description: Growth progress (plants) — stored as an integer by Unity

trtInd.description: Index of the associated terraformation stage

liId.description: Id of an internal list (logistics, drones)

liPlanet.description: Numeric planet id of the linked inventory `liId`, which is not the planet the object itself stands on: the two differ on all 21 occurrences observed, every one of them on an InterplanetaryExchangePlatform1. An object that names a linked planet also names the linked inventory.

text.description: Text displayed on the object (signs, panels)

liGrps.description: Logistic groups associated with the object

linkedWo.description: → WorldObject.id — id of the linked world object (e.g. machine ↔ inventory)

siIds.description: CSV ids of the sub-inventories internal to the object

woIds.description: → WorldObject.id — CSV ids of the world objects the object holds, remapped by the merge (GR-ID-3 in docs/game-rules.md). Not observed in the ten reference saves, where an object's contents are reached through its inventory instead.

trtVal.description: Numeric contribution to terraformation — stored as an integer by Unity. An object that holds a contribution also names the stage it contributes to.

hunger.description: Hunger level of an animal, observed on entries of gId DNASequence only — 345 occurrences over the 190338 world objects surveyed, ranging from -100 to 94.22. The bounds are the symmetric scale the game is assumed to work on, an animal yielding a DNA sequence while its hunger is positive; they come from that reading rather than from a source, and the first legitimate save they reject lifts them. (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)
